detection_id.description: text-bottle-quad80-v1: same-image real COCO bottle (class 39), center inside and >=80% quad intersection area, unique smallest bbox; otherwise null. Worker recomputes. No synthetic label/container.
Same nullable bottle association as the paired TextRegion; it identifies the bottle, not an invented label detection.

OCRField.description: ocr-fields-v1: actual unique bottle, all 1-2 consecutive source lines with original text/confidence/crop. crop_id is first source only; raw_text joins sources with LF and confidence is min. Worker recomputes full ordered fields; no chemical/date facts.
